decision: Do not integrate current bounded trust implementation without a general fallback; systematic native-convergent regressions remain.

candidate.message: bounded Newton did not produce an improved point

cause: Trust scales abs(current coordinate) depend on translation. For shift C >> Newton step, ratio is small, so second restart merely adds20 halvings. Native can converge after >40 halvings; candidate exhausts before any accepted step.

other_regression.candidate: accepts enormous full first step because second residual improves L2 merit; next Jacobian numerically singular after3 callbacks

minimal_general_remedy: On bounded proposal failure, invalid/degenerate Jacobian, or residual-check failure, retain original initial coordinates and try original MDNewton with every callback guarded by check_deadline; independently certify every original residual and bounds. This preserves original fallback behavior while allowing bounded success fast path. An absolute-coordinate scale tweak alone does not fix translation invariance or mixed-merit overshoot.
limitations: These are local-solver correctness/generalization counterexamples, not whole-solver runtime comparisons. Outer LM/rank-aware paths may recover some failures; current bounded helper itself loses systematic native convergence.

Initial180 grid used shift1e90,dps120/180,tol1e-70; native relative stopping at large coordinate contaminated translated comparisons. Do not use initial translated cases as evidence. Repeated at shift1e60,dps200/350,tol1e-130 so native final residual certification succeeds. Initial unshifted mixed-merit counter remains valid.
No claim all nonlinear systems should converge; comparisons require the native method to pass the same final residual test.
